How to Get a Business Email for Less Than $7

Set up a professional custom-domain email and use Gmail to receive and send messages from it — without paying for an expensive email suite.

A professional business email makes your communication look more credible and keeps your brand consistent. This guide walks you through registering a domain, creating a custom mailbox, and connecting it to Gmail so you can send and receive business email from one familiar inbox.

Step 1: Register your domain

Log in to namecheap.com and register your desired domain for less than $7 using the promo code NEWCOM679.

Step 2: Set up email forwarding

Go to your Namecheap dashboard and find the domain you just purchased. Click Manage, then click Add Forwarder. In the Alias field, enter the name you want to use, such as contact or info. In the Forward To field, enter your existing email address. Click the check icon to save.

Step 3: Test your business email

Send an email to your new business email address, such as hello@madebyolayinka.online. Then check your Gmail inbox to see whether the email has arrived.

Step 4: Check your Gmail inbox

You should now see the email in your Gmail inbox. However, you cannot yet reply using your business email address. The following steps explain how to set that up.

Step 5: Open App passwords

In Gmail, click the nine-dot Google apps icon and select Account. Search for App passwords and click the matching result.

Step 6: Generate an app password

Enter an app name and click Create. Copy and keep the generated app password.

Step 7: Add your business email to Gmail

Go back to Gmail and click the settings icon in the top-right corner. Click See all settings, then select Accounts and Import. Find Send mail as and click Add another email address.

Step 8: Enter your name and business email

Enter your desired name and your business email address, then click Next Step.

Step 9: Configure SMTP and confirm your email

In the SMTP Server field, enter smtp.gmail.com. For the username, enter your Gmail address. For the password, enter the app password you generated in Step 6. Click Continue.

You should receive a confirmation email in your Gmail inbox. Click the link in the email, then click Confirm.

Go back to your Gmail settings. Your business email address should now appear under Send mail as. You can make it your default address by clicking Make default, so future emails sent from Gmail use your business email address.

When composing an email, you can choose which address to send from by selecting it from the list of email addresses in the From field.

Thank you.
